baseline_boundaries.Kelle: FP16 original full KV vs W8A16+KV eviction/recompute+simulated eDRAM retention faults; combined loss
baseline_boundaries.DS-CIM: FP8 vs T256 FP8-to-INT8 alignment plus stochastic error injection; no PPL
baseline_boundaries.ARTEMIS: FP32 vs quantized then stochastic; BLEU is not PPL
baseline_boundaries.CQ-CiM: Embedding/retrieval changes; LLM remains FP16; not decoder arithmetic quality
baseline_boundaries.Analog FM: v3 Table1; hardware-aware training and simulated measured-device-derived PCM noise, not physical full LLM execution

numeric_not_transcribed.UniCAIM: F1 curves without exact numeric labels; no graph-digitized exact numbers
numeric_not_transcribed.SCARLET: Original accuracy difference axis -0.11% for Llama2-13B; relative vs percentage-point formula not reconstructed; no PPL
numeric_not_transcribed.PCM ALBERT: Uses GLUE; iso-accuracy defined as HW exceeding99% of FP accuracy; not a decoder LLM
